thread_title: Butterflies on Sarracenia or other carnivorous plants
breadcrumb: Butterflies on Sarracenia or other carnivorous plants

posts.body_html:
Here's a thread for some butterflies interacting with Sarracenia! Feel free to post your butterfly pics here, I think a lot of us would love to see them!


Never thought I'd see one of these in my yard, but a monarch was hovering over the leucophylla collection for several hours, and after about 40 minutes of chasing it, I finally got one shot of it before it took off! It landed on a leuco trap for less than 2 seconds, so I had almost no chance of getting a pic of it on the Sarracenia. I showed this pic to my daughter Ellie, and her immediate response was "no fair" followed by a tone of deep jealousy. I felt bad and told her to go out into the yard more often instead of staying on the dang IPAD all day. GOSH! LOL


For those of you who are good at ID, would love to know what species (or common name) for this one. The colors are almost unbelievable! Given the amazing colors and patterns, seems like this is the sort of butterfly you'd find in the tropics:


Took so many tries to get a good shot, here's a bad shot but on a nice trap!




I'll try to dig up some other butterfly pics in situ, pretty sure I have them. In the meantime, let's see what you guys have!
